sources.used_for: Squad values and ages, transfers and fees, coach histories, player league minutes, line-ups and formations
sources.coverage: Values from 2004-05; other data full era

models.name: Squad-value model
models.summary: PPG = a + b·log(club squad value ÷ league average), fitted by OLS on every PL club-season since 2004-05. A residual is actual PPG minus predicted; it is converted to league places using that season's own table. Squad market value stands in for wages because no open wage-bill data covers every club.

models.name: Dixon-Coles
models.summary: Per-season attack and defence strengths, home advantage and a low-score correction (rho), fitted by maximum likelihood with an analytic gradient and a sum-to-zero constraint on log-attack. Finished seasons weight every game equally; the season in progress also uses the previous season, down-weighted by exponential time decay (xi = 0.0019/day).

models.name: Monte Carlo
models.summary: 10,000 seeded simulations per season. Finished seasons replay every fixture; the current season keeps real results and simulates the rest. Reports points percentiles, title, top-four and relegation probabilities, and a convergence check.

models.name: Market expected points
models.summary: Expected points implied by average bookmaker odds (normalised to remove the margin). Used in place of xG-based expected points, which needed data we could not source.

models.name: Elo
models.summary: Standard football Elo (K=20, home advantage 65, goal-margin multiplier), computed from league results and warmed up on 1985-92 First Division games. PL games only.

models.name: Change points
models.summary: PELT (ruptures, L2 cost) on United's rolling 19-game PPG and Elo, run at seven penalties. A break counts as real only if it appears at half or more of the penalties.

models.name: Manager bounce
models.summary: Every PL managerial spell of 10+ league games, aligned at the new manager's first game; mean points per game from -10 to +40, smoothed over 5 games. United's spells are compared with every other club's.

models.name: Tenure clusters
models.summary: Big-six tenures of 19+ league games described by PPG, net spend per season, squad age and Elo change per season; standardised, k-means with k chosen by silhouette score, PCA for the 2D view.

models.name: Transfer ROI
models.summary: Big-six signings over £10m in today's money: league minutes, starts, goals plus assists per 90, resale fee and net cost per 1,000 league minutes.

assumptions: All money is in pounds at the latest UK CPI price level. Euro figures from Transfermarkt use the ECB annual average rate for the season's start year; the 1999 rate is used before the euro existed.
Seasons run from July to June. United's financial year ends on 30 June and maps to the season ending in it.
Points per game everywhere: 1992-95 seasons had 42 games.
Only known transfer fees count. Unknown fees are excluded, not treated as free transfers. Loans are excluded.
A season's net spend is split between managers in proportion to the league games each managed that season.
Signings are credited to the United manager in charge on 1 September of the signing season.
League games only for manager records, line-ups and minutes.

# DATA GAPS

Generated by `analysis/export.py` on 2026-10-14. Nothing listed here was estimated
or invented: missing values are `null` in the JSON and show as **NO DATA** on the site.

## Unavailable sources

- **xG and shots (Understat, FBref).** Understat's robots.txt disallows all crawlers and FBref
  returned HTTP 403, so there is no xG. Affected: xG difference per manager (null),
  xG-based expected points (replaced by *bookmaker-odds* expected points, clearly labelled),
  and the xG feature in tenure clustering (dropped).
- **ClubElo API.** HTTP 502 on every attempt. Elo is computed from league results instead
  (`models/elo.py`). It covers PL games only, not cups or Europe.

## Financial data

- **Wage bills for every PL club.** No open dataset exists (Deloitte, Capology and Statista
  are paywalled). The spending model uses Transfermarkt **squad market value** as the resource
  measure (2004-05 onward). To fit the true wage model, add `analysis/data/manual/club_wages.csv`
  (`season,team,wages_gbp`) from published accounts; the pipeline picks it up automatically.
- **Squad market values before 2004-05.** Transfermarkt has none, so the model covers 2004-05 onward.
- **United financials before FY2016.** SEC XBRL data starts with the FY2018 20-F, which restates
  FY2016-17. Available: FY2016-FY2025. Earlier 20-F filings (FY2012-15) are HTML/PDF only and
  were not hand-transcribed. Glazer-era outflows from 2005 to 2015 are therefore missing, so the
  site's outflow totals cover the filed years only.
- **Rival clubs' wages-to-revenue and cost per point.** Not available (same reason as wages).
  Rival comparisons use squad value and net transfer spend instead.
- **Debt issue costs** appear in XBRL for only some years. Other years are null, not zero.

## Transfers

- Transfermarkt fees are reported figures and may exclude add-ons. Unknown fees (11% of non-loan moves) are excluded.
- Pre-1999 euro figures are converted at the 1999 ECB rate.
- No transfer dates on season pages, so summer and winter windows cannot be separated when
  crediting spend to managers (proportional split used instead).

## Line-up coverage (United league games with a recorded XI)

| Manager | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Alex Ferguson | 761/810 league games (94%) |
| David Moyes | 34/34 league games (100%) |
| Ryan Giggs (interim) | 4/4 league games (100%) |
| Louis van Gaal | 76/76 league games (100%) |
| José Mourinho | 93/93 league games (100%) |
| Ole Gunnar Solskjaer (interim) | 13/13 league games (100%) |
| Ole Gunnar Solskjaer | 96/96 league games (100%) |
| Michael Carrick (interim) | 2/2 league games (100%) |
| Ralf Rangnick (interim) | 24/24 league games (100%) |
| Erik ten Hag | 85/85 league games (100%) |
| Ruud van Nistelrooy (interim) | 2/2 league games (100%) |
| Ruben Amorim | 47/47 league games (100%) |
| Darren Fletcher (interim) | 1/1 league games (100%) |

| Michael Carrick | 7/7 league games (100%) |

## Manager portraits

Free-licence portraits found for 12 of 12 people. Initials fallback used for:
none.

## Other limitations

- Older Transfermarkt match reports (mostly before 2002) list starters by position group, not on a
  pitch. For those games the formation is *inferred* from the group counts (e.g. 4 defenders,
  4 midfielders, 2 forwards = 4-4-2) and left-to-right positions are approximate. The site flags
  this as "INFERRED".
- Elo ratings for 1992-93 depend on the 1985-92 warm-up period.
- Trophy dates for league titles are approximate. They are only used to attribute each
  trophy to a manager.
- Interim flags are hand-checked for United only. For rivals, short spells are simply
  filtered out (fewer than 10 or 19 league games, depending on the model).
- The bounce baseline needs 10 PL games before a change. For a newly promoted club these
  can come from an earlier PL spell.
